brief:
The Israeli army demolished one of the last Palestinian communities in the Jordan Valley region of the occupied West Bank, Middle East Eye reported. The demolition targeted a settlement in an area where few Palestinian population centers remain.

The Jordan Valley, which comprises roughly one-third of the West Bank, has seen extensive Israeli settlement expansion and Palestinian displacement over decades. Palestinian communities in the region face ongoing pressure from military operations and settlement activities.
dek: Israeli army demolishes one of the last Palestinian communities in Jordan Valley The Israeli army has destroyed one of the last Palestinian communities in the Jordan Valley in the occupied West Bank.
title: Israeli army destroys Palestinian community in Jordan Valley
